summary.content:
Today's selection covers 86 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 57 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Version of AI tool 'too powerful for public' released to public
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Microsoft AI chief walks back comments about AI taking over white-collar work
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 59 articles published in the last 24 hours
